lines: My father cut stone. His father cut stone. I keep the accounts.
Somebody has to know what the stone is actually worth.
Lately the Foundation pays over the odds for anything off the west face.
Chippings. Dust. I sold them a barrow of dust in June and they thanked me.

sw_house_a_child: That gap on the wall is Grandad's chisel. He's got it with him.
He's been retired eleven years. He still takes it out.
Mum says he goes and sits on the terrace and doesn't cut anything.
